aza3.reason: The README declares a distinct Chapter-3 question, fail-closed handoff contract, ranked history discriminators and an empty own-individual intake ledger. It therefore owns a real scientific gate even though own biological data are currently zero.

284b.reason: It currently declares no independent scientific question, inferential object, claim ceiling, input/output contract or terminal condition. Therefore it must not be promoted to open/result/bounded merely because a repository exists.
284b.promotion_gate: Declare a question that is not already owned by SDMR, define the inherited v2.8.4 boundary, specify evidence and terminal outcomes, and state non-transfer rules. Otherwise merge the work back into SDMR or retain it as staging.
